185670.overview:
A new enemy has summoned evil and killed all of the heroes! Discover the world of Greyhawk and stop Iuz's campaign to conquer the Kingdom of Furyondy! Undertake daring missions to rescue allies, sabotage enemy strongholds and find the secret to defeating this threat once and for all!

Created by Counte Monte on the OpenBOR engine, Dungeons and Dragons: The Rise of Warduke is not just a button-mashing beat 'em up but mixes in a bit of role-playing adventure as you visit towns across the map, talk to NPC's and fight random encounters. There are 13 playable characters, some of whom must be unlocked like dark elves and necromancers, who can learn dozens of spells, buy weapons and equipment, complete quests, hire mercenaries, solve puzzles and traps, find secret dungeons, joust for prizes, and much more!

198734.overview: Retro Gamer Adventure is an OpenBOR beat 'em up released in 2019 by Brazilian creator ZVitor. Similar in style to River City Ransom, it features 15 real-life playable characters from YouTube's gaming community with fully-voiced story sequences in Portuguese. Each character has a special move and costume set that takes inspiration from comics and video game culture. For example, ZVitor himself is playable and has the ability to blast enemies with an infinity stone gauntlet on his hand, donning an Aquaman suit when his power-up meter fills up. The game has great graphics and charming level design, with lots of fun characters to brawl with and against.

216696.overview:
Ryuko No Ken Nekketsu (the Japanese name for 'Art of Fighting') is a 'beat 'em up' inspired by Nintendo's legendary River City Ransom. Here, you can choose from various characters to hit the dangerous streets of Japan and take down the gangs and other city scum.

Ryuko No Ken Nekketsu provides you with more than a dozen different characters, depending on the playing mode you choose. There is classic arcade mode, but also some additional options for you to show off your fighting skills.

Some of the available characters include, of course, Robert Garcia and Ryo Sakazaki from 'Art of Fighting', among others.

As you play, you can explore many different streets with vastly different styles. That's where you'll find more weapons and healing objects, which will be necessary to fight the game's different final bosses, who are way harder than the normal enemies.

Ryuko No Ken Nekketsu is a 2D action game that maintains the 'brawler' spirit from late 80s/early 90s games. And its graphics, directly inspired by the same games, are truly a delight.

216728.overview:
Art of Fighting Kids is the version port of Ryuko no Ken Nekketsu: Wii Edition adapted for Sega DreamCast thanks to Ripfire. This game is a lite version of the full version for PC (due to the limitation of the RAM of the console), it contains the 1st story of Art Of Fighting and you can only select the two friends; Ryo Sakazaki and Robert Garcia.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Art of Fighting Kids es el porte de la versión de Ryuko no Ken Nekketsu: Wii Edition adaptado para Sega DreamCast gracias a Ripfire. Este juego es una versión menor de la completa version para PC (por la limitación del RAM de la consola), contiene la 1era historia de Art Of Fighting y solo puedes seleccionar a los dos amigos; Ryo Sakazaki y Robert García.

216806.overview:
The Return of Double Dragon is a Open Beats of Rage Mod tribute to the Technos Japan series of beat 'em up games that originated back in 1987. The original Double Dragon games spanned over some classic consoles including the Nintendo Entertainment System (NES), Sega Master System (SMS), Atari 2600, Nintendo Game Boy, Sega Genesis / Mega Drive and Atari Lynx.

This really is a must-have; even for people who never played Double Dragon before. It features the original plot that this game was supposed to have, but sadly got cut into the versions we all know...

- Mr.Q

Source: https://dcevolution.sourceforge.net/index.php?id=return_of_double_dragon

Ripfire: ''Bloodbane presents its new project using the OpenBOR engine, but this time it will not be a street fighting game, but rather, a Shoot'Em Up called Rainbow, a simple but very entertaining game ... Rainbow: DreamCast Edition is exclusively for Sega DreamCast, I've Re-edited some concept of the author.''

Rainbow: DreamCast Edition es exclusivamente para Sega DreamCast, he re-editados algunos concepto del autor...."

216979.overview:
We can choose 5 characters, including a girl who looks like a big bear. The tricks of the 5 people are similar, but the attack power of the big bear is stronger, and the flying legs of the national husband are more experienced. The game uses more passionate and hardcore actions and backgrounds in the N.E.S. The BOSS in each level is well designed. The last level is the underworld boss, but I'm even more impressed with the boss in the penultimate level. He defeated all 3 groups of bad girl players, and then played a BOSS who looked like our big bear in women's clothing. The look is very impressive. :)

This is excellent work. It feels more fun than the original versions of N.E.S. and M.A.M.E. There are 6 levels in the game. You can also collect accessories like bats, shovels, and flower discs for battle!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Podemos elegir 5 personajes, incluida una niña que se parece a un gran oso. Los trucos de las 5 personas son similares, pero el poder de ataque del gran oso es más fuerte y las piernas voladoras del marido nacional tienen más experiencia. El juego usa acciones y fondos más apasionados y duros en los juegos de N.E.S. El JEFE en cada nivel está bien diseñado. El último nivel es el jefe del inframundo, pero estoy aún más impresionado con el jefe en el penúltimo nivel. Derrotó a los 3 grupos de jugadores de chicas malas, y luego jugó con un JEFE que se parecía a nuestro gran oso con ropa de mujer. El look es muy impresionante. :)

Este es un trabajo excelente. Se siente más divertido que las versiones originales de N.E.S. y M.A.M.E. Hay 6 niveles en el juego. ¡También puedes recoger accesorios como murciélagos, palas y discos de flores para la batalla!

371327.overview:
This is a kind of hack for Double Dragon: "Sleeping Dragon" initially published on Lavalit.com and created for the OpenBor engine by Master Mr. Q, and presents the original plot that was supposed to have this game had, but unfortunately it was cut In the versions we all know ...

The Perfect Uncle Wa version is a revision of the V3.00 version game for Sega Dreamcast, in this adds new characteristics to the game as technic to fighters, new enemies and also expands the history of the game. The only negative point is history as dialogs are in complete Chinese.

Ripfire adapted this last revision for Sega Dreamcast using special scripts for the new engine, DreamBOR.

447862.overview:
Lord J has your sister and the city under his grip. Grab your buddy Ozzie and take to the streets. Clean house, save Maria and bring Neo-Cisco out of the shadows!

Watch out for cheap shots, and don't miss an opportunity to dish out a few of your own. Grab punks from behind and make em' kiss concrete! Surrounded and in trouble? Harness your anger and no one can stop you!

453163.overview: Created by Volcanic, Rocket Viper 2 is a heavily scripted module loaded with special effects and functionality. Wield an array of unique abilities from a huge selection of fighters. Stay alert! Enemies are plentiful and powerful. Think you can spam your way through? Think again. You'll need to manage resources carefully thanks to a system of energy reserve and cool downs. Fight strategically if you hope to make it through this gauntlet!

453171.overview: This demo is simple and straight forward. Choose SNK's 94 poster boy Kyo or Falcoon's infamous insert Alba Meira and and tear up the streets!

453174.overview: The second installment of Rescue Command, featuring multiple playable characters.

453175.overview: A somewhat difficult Rocket Viper 2 clone by OzGames. "Attack the Prison" sees Arcueid being sent to Amazon Island to rescue hostages, while "The Prisoner" sees Norimaro trying to escape the high-security prison on the island.

453176.overview: Following in the footsteps of the first Rhythm of Destruction, this second outing ups the ante with an all new quest, more fighters, and new music you're sure to enjoy. Choose your favorite edition, each with a unique sound track and character selections.

453177.overview:
There's no story, no rhyme, and no reason. Just pick a favorite from this unusual crew, and get moving. Some scripted effects and other touches do help the game stand out a bit from some of its contemporaries.

455918.overview:
For years the Umbrella corporation has developed deadly bio-organic weapons for military purposes. Its legacy was carried over by underworld terrorist organizations, but only a group of people can stop them.
​RESIDENT EVIL: SURVIVE is a side-scroller action/horror beat em up game developed with the OpenBOR engine and based on CAPCOM's most iconic survival horror franchise of the same name. The game takes inspiration from THE MERCENARIES bonus game originally introduced in RESIDENT EVIL 3: NEMESIS with a retro-inspired look.
- Arcade-oriented pacing
- Local coop for 4 players
- The groundbreaking pixel art introduced in the CPS2 arcade system.
- Play as the most iconic and legendary heroes and villains.
- Revive some of the most memorable moments experienced throughout the history of the franchise.
- 2 Capcom special guest characters.
- 2 Classic survival horror guest characters.
- Survive waves of zombies, parasites and other mutant creatures alone, or along other 3 partners.

457328.overview: Rescue-Palooza: Fall of the Foot Clan is a remake of the Game Boy game released in 1990. This remake includes a "Foot Clan Mode" allowing players to control Shredder, Krang, Bebop and Rocksteady. The Foot Clan Mode features new bosses, as well as brand-new cutscenes with multiple endings.
